title: Schema failures of SCM settings and secrets answer 400 without naming the offending setting in details.setting
resolution: The API server checks each entry of settings and secrets alone against ScmSettings or ScmSecrets and names the first refused one in details.setting, never its value; POST and PATCH tests cover a bad name, an empty secret, and values that are no string.

title: The migration's origin check admits ports above 65535, which NormalizedOrigin forbids
resolution: The migration's port pattern is that of NormalizedOrigin, 1 to 65535; the migration test refuses 0, 65536, and 99999 and accepts 65535.

title: No shared conformance suite runs the ScmIntegrations store contract against both the PostgreSQL and the in-memory adapter
resolution: SCM_INTEGRATIONS_CONFORMANCE in the module's ports runs against both the in-memory and the PostgreSQL store: creation and readback, missing records, pages, whole-settings and named-secret replacement, and revision conflicts; sealing and overlap tests stay PostgreSQL-specific.

title: Most fail-before runs stopped at missing exports, so the behavior assertions never ran before the implementation
resolution: verification.md records behavior negative controls, one mutation each of normalization, replacement, compare-and-set, sealing context, verifier cache, HTTP 409, plugin checks, redaction, and the key at start, with the failing tests, apart from the historical test-first evidence.

title: The store's reads run in read-write SERIALIZABLE transactions, so each webhook read can abort a concurrent update
resolution: Open: the pass 2 fix round resolves it.

title: An update opens every stored secret, so one secret that no longer opens blocks every update, even the one replacing it
resolution: Open: the pass 2 fix round resolves it.

title: Stored verifiers drop a missing plugin or a failed provider build without telling the operator
resolution: Open: the pass 2 fix round resolves it.
